note: Expectations for the synthetic corpus, fixed before any engine work (track 1d). Judged like a careful recruiter with the job-matching skill rubric. band = expected score range 0-100 (width <= 30; the effective score of an unscorable or absent job is 0). status = scored | excluded | unscorable. violations = decided hard-criterion violations (anue, country, dayRate, availability). checks = codes the engine should raise instead of deciding. mustOpen = case-insensitive substrings of must requirements that must NOT count as met.
